chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abu al-Jahm, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Ahmad ibn Muslim, who said: A man asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) while he was performing the circumambulation (Tawaf), and said to him: Inform me about the Munificent (al-Jawad).

He said: Indeed, your speech has two aspects. If you are asking about the created, then the Munificent is the one who fulfills what Allah has obligated upon him. And if you are asking about the Creator, He is the Munificent when He gives, and He is the Munificent when He withholds, because when He gives you, He gives you what is not yours, and when He withholds, He withholds from you what is not yours.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Munificent among the created and the Munificent as the Creator?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the semantic duality of 'al-Jawad' by distinguishing between the created and the Creator. For the created, it refers to fulfilling obligations, while for the Creator, it signifies that both giving and withholding are acts of munificence because He gives what is not ours and withholds what is not ours.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, from his father, from Abu’l-Jahm, from Musa bin Bikr, from Ahmad bin Muslim, that he said: A man asked Abu’l-Hasan, peace be upon him, while he was during the circling, so he said to him: Inform me about the munificent.

He said: Indeed, to your speech are two indications. If you were to ask about the created, the munificent is, indeed, the one who fulfils what Allah has obliged upon him. If you were to ask about the Creator, He is the Munificent when He gives, and He is the Munificent when He prevents, because when He gives you, He gives you what is not yours, and when He prevents, He prevents you from what is not yours.
